title: 3. Article (A, An, The) र Noun-का प्रकार
group: मोड्युल १ · शून्यदेखि दक्षतासम्म: आधारभूत Grammar Engine
blocks: बंगाली भाषीहरूले सबैभन्दा धेरै गल्ती गर्ने एउटै ठाउँ। Countable र uncountable noun, ३ वटा article र zero article, proofreading-का लागि ४ चरणको निर्णय गर्ने तरिका, र fixed case-हरू।

यो पूरै किताबमा तपाईंले एउटा मात्र chapter सुधार्नुहुन्छ भने, यही सुधार्नुहोस्। जसको मातृभाषामा article हुँदैन, उनीहरूका लागि article नै सबैभन्दा धेरै गल्ती हुने एउटै ठाउँ हो, र बंगाली, हिन्दी, उर्दू र नेपाली — कुनैमा पनि a / an / the-को सिधा मिल्ने शब्द छैन। यो सानोतिनो कुरा होइन। अरू कुरामा बलियो Band 7 स्तरका candidate-हरू पनि Band 6.0 मै अड्किनुको एक नम्बर कारण article-को गल्ती हो, किनभने यी गल्ती बारम्बार हुन्छन्, लगभग हरेक वाक्यमा देखिन्छन्, र तपाईंको कानले यिनलाई समात्न सक्दैन: तपाईंको मातृभाषाले कानलाई त्यसको अभ्यास कहिल्यै गराएन।
तपाईं a / an प्रयोग गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ कि सक्नुहुन्न भन्ने कुरा यही फरकमा भर पर्छ, त्यसैले article-का नियमभन्दा पहिले यो सिक्नुहोस्।
Countable noun गन्न सकिन्छ र यसको plural रूप हुन्छ: one book, two books; a student, five students। Singular-मा यिनले a / an लिन सक्छन्।
Uncountable noun-लाई एउटै पूरा मात्रा (mass) मानिन्छ; यसको plural रूप हुँदैन र a / an पनि लाग्दैन: information (कहिल्यै informations होइन), water, advice।

बंगलादेशी candidate-हरू धेरै चिप्लिने, धेरै प्रयोग हुने uncountable noun-हरू, जसलाई एउटै block-का रूपमा कण्ठ गर्नु राम्रो: information, advice, knowledge, research, equipment, furniture, accommodation, traffic, progress, news, money, water, work, luggage, baggage, software, staff, homework, feedback, transport, machinery, vocabulary।
Uncountable noun गन्नुपर्दा partitive phrase (एकाइ जनाउने शब्द) र of प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्:
a study / a piece of research
a piece of furniture / an item of furniture
Article ३ वटा छन् (a, an, the), र चौथो विकल्प पनि छ: कुनै article नै नराख्ने, जसलाई zero article भनिन्छ। हरेक singular countable noun-का लागि यी ४ मध्ये एउटा सोचेर छान्नुपर्छ।

एउटा, निश्चित नगरिएको, singular, countable चीजका लागि a / an प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्, प्रायः पहिलो पटक उल्लेख गर्दा। a र an मध्ये कुन छान्ने भन्ने कुरा उच्चारणको आवाजमा भर पर्छ, हिज्जेमा होइन। Vowel आवाजअघि an, consonant आवाजअघि a प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
a university, a European country (यी “y” consonant आवाजबाट सुरु हुन्छन्)
an hour, an honest man (h उच्चारण हुँदैन, त्यसैले vowel आवाज)
an MBA, an X-ray (vowel आवाजबाट सुरु हुने अक्षरका नाम)
I saw a documentary last night. (पहिलो उल्लेख, निश्चित नगरिएको) / She wants to become an engineer. (एक जना, निश्चित नगरिएको)
Noun निश्चित हुँदा, अर्थात् पाठक वा सुन्नेलाई तपाईंले ठ्याक्कै कुनको कुरा गर्दै हुनुहुन्छ भन्ने थाहा हुँदा, the प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। यस्तो धेरै तरिकाले हुन्छ:
पहिले नै उल्लेख भइसकेको छ: I saw a documentary. The documentary was about climate change.
त्यो एउटा मात्र छ: the sun, the government, the internet, the environment।
वरपरका शब्दले त्यसलाई निश्चित बनाएका छन्: the number of cars, the graph above, the capital of Bangladesh।
Superlative र ordinal-सँग: the highest figure, the most important factor, the first step।
The chart shows the number of visitors. (दुवै निश्चित) / Solar power is the cleanest option available. (superlative)
यी अवस्थामा कुनै article प्रयोग नगर्नुहोस्:
सामान्य अर्थमा भनिएका plural countable noun: Books are expensive. Cars cause pollution.
सामान्य अर्थमा भनिएका uncountable noun: Water is essential. Education matters. Poverty is rising.
धेरैजसो proper noun: धेरैजसो देश, सहर, मानिस र भाषाका नाम: Bangladesh, Dhaka, English।
Education is a basic right. (सामान्य uncountable, zero article) / Cars contribute to pollution. (सामान्य plural + सामान्य uncountable)
3.3 निर्णय गर्ने तरिका (proofread गर्दा यो प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्)
कुनै पनि singular noun जाँच्दा यी प्रश्न क्रमैसँग सोध्नुहोस्:
यो countable हो? होइन भने (uncountable), a / an प्रयोग गर्न मिल्दैन। निश्चित भए the, सामान्य भए zero article छान्नुहोस्। यहीँ रोकिनुहोस्।
हो भने (countable): यो निश्चित, थाहा भएको, वा एउटा मात्र (unique) हो? हो भने the प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
निश्चित होइन र singular हो भने: a / an प्रयोग गर्नुहोस् (उच्चारणको आवाज हेरेर)।
सामान्य अर्थको plural हो भने: zero article प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
केही article-को छनोट पक्का (fixed) हुन्छ, र यिनलाई छुट्टाछुट्टै item-का रूपमा सिक्नुपर्छ:
the internet, the environment, the economy, the government, the media, the public, the world — यिनले the लिन्छन् (एउटा मात्र भएको मानिन्छ)।
Superlative ले सधैं the लिन्छ: the best, the largest, the most significant।
संस्थालाई त्यसको मूल कामका लागि प्रयोग गर्दा zero article लाग्छ: go to school, go to university, go to hospital (British प्रयोग), in prison, at home। निश्चित भवन भन्न खोज्दा मात्र the थप्नुहोस्।

देश: धेरैजसो देशले zero article लिन्छन् (Bangladesh, France, China), तर केही plural वा “united/republic” भएका नामले the लिन्छन्: the United States, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, the Philippines।

पहिलो उल्लेख र त्यसपछि दोस्रो उल्लेख: a ले चिनाउनुहोस्, the ले फेरि उल्लेख गर्नुहोस्। examiner-हरूले खोज्ने परम्परागत a बाट the-मा जाने चाल यही हो: The chart shows a sharp rise in 2018. The rise continued into 2019.
बंगाली भाषीहरू article-मा किन गल्ती गर्छन्

बंगाली भाषामा article नै छैन, त्यसैले तपाईंको मनको grammar-मा यो वर्ग नै हुँदैन; त्यसैले यसलाई अनुवाद गरेर होइन, English-को मात्र छुट्टै प्रणालीका रूपमा सिक्नुपर्छ। ३ वटा गल्तीका ढाँचा सबैभन्दा धेरै देखिन्छन्।

Error type 1 · निश्चित र एउटा मात्र भएका चीजअघि “the” छुटाउनु।
✗ Internet has changed our lives. / Government should fund school.
✓ The internet has changed our lives. / The government should fund schools.

Error type 2 · Uncountable noun-सँग “a / an” प्रयोग गर्नु। यही हो “an advice / an information” गल्ती।
✗ He gave me an advice. / She did a research on it.
✓ He gave me some advice / a piece of advice. / She did research / a study on it.

Error type 3 · Singular countable noun-अघि article पूरै छुटाउनु।
✗ Government should take step to reduce pollution.
✓ The government should take steps to reduce pollution.
Band 6 मै अड्किने एक नम्बर कारण

हरेक task-मा article-को नियन्त्रण धेरै बाक्लोसँग जाँचिन्छ। Task 1-मा एउटै वाक्यमा ३ वटा छुट्टाछुट्टै article-निर्णय चाहिन सक्छ: “The chart shows the number of visitors to a museum.” Task 2-का सामान्यीकरणमा ढाँचा उल्टिएर zero article र the-मा पुग्छ: “Governments should protect the environment.” गल्ती यति धेरै हुने भएकाले नै यो त्यो परम्परागत फरक हो, जसका कारण idea-मा Band 7 जस्तो लाग्ने script-ले Grammatical Range and Accuracy-मा Band 6 पाउँछ।

काम लाग्ने skill: Writing, Speaking
Task 1: The graph illustrates the proportion of households with an internet connection.
Task 2: Education is widely seen as the key to development, and governments should therefore fund schools properly.
Speaking Part 2: The person who influenced me most was a teacher at my primary school.
Chapter 3 यहीँ सकियो। त्यसपछि Chapter 4 (Prepositions & Dependency Rules) आउँछ।

title: 3. Practice · Article (A, An, The) र Noun-का प्रकार
group: मोड्युल १ · शून्यदेखि दक्षतासम्म: आधारभूत Grammar Engine
blocks: हरेक singular countable noun-का लागि सोचेर एउटा छनोट गर्नुपर्छ: a/an, the, वा कुनै article नै नराख्ने। नियम एउटै प्रश्नमा टिकेको छ -- यो noun लेख्ने र पढ्ने दुवैका लागि निश्चित हो कि होइन?
**किन महत्त्वपूर्ण:** बंगलादेशी candidate-हरूको लेखाइमा article-का गल्ती सबैभन्दा धेरै हुने -- र सबैभन्दा देखिने -- गल्तीमध्ये पर्छन्, किनभने बंगाली भाषामा article-को कुनै प्रणाली नै छैन।

**a/an** -- एउटा, निश्चित नगरिएको, singular, countable चीज, प्रायः पहिलो उल्लेख। छनोट **उच्चारणको आवाजमा भर पर्छ, हिज्जेमा होइन**: a university (consonant आवाज), an hour (h उच्चारण हुँदैन, vowel आवाज)।
**the** -- noun निश्चित छ: पहिले नै उल्लेख भइसकेको, एउटा मात्र भएको (the sun, the government), वा वरपरका शब्दले निश्चित बनाएको (the number of cars)।
**zero article** -- सामान्य अर्थमा प्रयोग भएका plural र uncountable noun, र धेरैजसो proper noun।

आफैंलाई सोध्नुहोस्: यो पहिले उल्लेख भइसकेको छ, वा यो एउटा मात्र छ? हो भने the प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। यो एउटा, निश्चित नगरिएको उदाहरण हो भने a/an प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। दुवै लागू हुँदैनन् भने कुनै article प्रयोग नगर्नुहोस्।

blocks.title: Exercise 3.1 · Article राख्ने
blocks.instructions: Article-हरू हटाइएका छन्। चाहिने ठाउँमा a, an, वा the राखेर हरेक वाक्य फेरि लेख्नुहोस्। केही खाली ठाउँमा zero article (कुनै शब्द नराख्ने) चाहिन्छ।

items.prompt: ___ education is ___ key to ___ economic development.
items.answer: Education is the key to economic development.
accepted: Education is the key to economic development.
items.reason: सामान्य uncountable “education” र “development” ले zero article लिन्छन्; “the key” निश्चित छ।

items.prompt: She is ___ most hard-working student in ___ class.
items.answer: She is the most hard-working student in the class.
accepted: She is the most hard-working student in the class.
items.reason: Superlative र एउटा निश्चित class, दुवैले “the” लिन्छन्।

items.prompt: ___ chart shows ___ number of tourists visiting ___ museum.
items.answer: The chart shows the number of tourists visiting a museum.
accepted: The chart shows the number of tourists visiting a museum.
items.reason: “the chart,” “the number of,” र पहिलो उल्लेख “a museum.”

items.prompt: ___ internet has transformed ___ way people communicate.
items.answer: The internet has transformed the way people communicate.
accepted: The internet has transformed the way people communicate.
items.reason: “the internet” एउटा मात्र छ; “the way” पछाडिको clause-ले निश्चित भएको छ।

items.prompt: He wants to become ___ honest lawyer after ___ university.
items.answer: He wants to become an honest lawyer after university.
accepted: He wants to become an honest lawyer after university.
items.reason: “honest”-को vowel आवाजअघि “an” (h उच्चारण हुँदैन); संस्थाका रूपमा “university” ले zero article लिन्छ।

items.prompt: ___ pollution is ___ serious problem in ___ major cities.
items.answer: Pollution is a serious problem in major cities.
accepted: Pollution is a serious problem in major cities.
items.reason: सामान्य uncountable “pollution”; पहिलो उल्लेख “a problem”; सामान्य plural “cities.”

items.prompt: I read ___ interesting article yesterday. ___ article was about ___ climate change.
items.answer: I read an interesting article yesterday. The article was about climate change.
accepted: I read an interesting article yesterday. The article was about climate change.
items.reason: पहिलो उल्लेख “an,” दोस्रो उल्लेख “the,” सामान्य “climate change.”

items.prompt: ___ government should invest more in ___ public transport.
items.answer: The government should invest more in public transport.
accepted: The government should invest more in public transport.
items.reason: “the government” निश्चित छ; “public transport” सामान्य uncountable हो।

items.prompt: ___ United States and ___ United Kingdom signed ___ agreement.
items.answer: The United States and the United Kingdom signed an agreement.
accepted: The United States and the United Kingdom signed an agreement.
items.reason: यी देशका नामले “the” लिन्छन्; पहिलो उल्लेख “an agreement.”

items.prompt: ___ sun rises in ___ east.
items.answer: The sun rises in the east.
accepted: The sun rises in the east.
items.reason: दुवै एउटा मात्र छन्।

items.prompt: ___ poverty remains ___ obstacle to ___ progress in ___ developing world.
items.answer: Poverty remains an obstacle to progress in the developing world.
accepted: Poverty remains an obstacle to progress in the developing world.
items.reason: सामान्य “poverty” र “progress”; पहिलो उल्लेख “an obstacle”; “the developing world” निश्चित छ।

items.prompt: She gave me ___ useful advice about ___ visa process.
items.answer: She gave me useful advice about the visa process.
accepted: She gave me useful advice about the visa process.
items.reason: “advice” uncountable हो (“a” लाग्दैन); “the visa process” निश्चित छ।

items.prompt: ___ number of ___ students who fail ___ exam is rising.
items.answer: The number of students who fail the exam is rising.
accepted: The number of students who fail the exam is rising.
items.reason: “the number of,” सामान्य “students,” निश्चित “exam.”

items.prompt: My brother is ___ engineer, and he works for ___ large company.
items.answer: My brother is an engineer, and he works for a large company.
accepted: My brother is an engineer, and he works for a large company.
items.reason: “an engineer” (vowel आवाज), पहिलो उल्लेख “a company.”

items.prompt: ___ water is essential for ___ life on ___ Earth.
items.answer: Water is essential for life on Earth.
accepted: Water is essential for life on Earth.
items.reason: सामान्य uncountable र proper noun “Earth” ले zero article लिन्छन्।

items.prompt: We stayed in ___ hotel near ___ airport; ___ hotel was cheap.
items.answer: We stayed in a hotel near the airport; the hotel was cheap.
accepted: We stayed in a hotel near the airport; the hotel was cheap.
items.reason: पहिलो उल्लेख “a hotel,” थाहा भएको “the airport,” दोस्रो उल्लेख “the hotel.”

items.prompt: ___ research shows that ___ exercise improves ___ mental health.
items.answer: Research shows that exercise improves mental health.
accepted: Research shows that exercise improves mental health.
items.reason: सबै सामान्य/uncountable, त्यसैले zero article।

items.prompt: ___ environment must be protected for ___ future generations.
items.answer: The environment must be protected for future generations.
accepted: The environment must be protected for future generations.
items.reason: “the environment” एउटा मात्र छ; “future generations” सामान्य plural।

items.prompt: He spent ___ hour reading ___ book about ___ history of ___ Bangladesh.
items.answer: He spent an hour reading a book about the history of Bangladesh.
accepted: He spent an hour reading a book about the history of Bangladesh.
items.reason: “an hour” (h उच्चारण हुँदैन), पहिलो उल्लेख “a book,” “the history of X” निश्चित, proper noun “Bangladesh” zero।

items.prompt: ___ traffic in ___ capital is ___ major source of ___ air pollution.
items.answer: The traffic in the capital is a major source of air pollution.
accepted: The traffic in the capital is a major source of air pollution.
items.reason: “the traffic” निश्चित, “the capital” निश्चित, पहिलो उल्लेख “a source,” सामान्य “air pollution.”

items.prompt: ___ knowledge is power, but ___ information alone is not ___ knowledge.
items.answer: Knowledge is power, but information alone is not knowledge.
accepted: Knowledge is power, but information alone is not knowledge.
items.reason: सबै सामान्य uncountable।

items.prompt: She is ___ best doctor in ___ hospital where I work.
items.answer: She is the best doctor in the hospital where I work.
accepted: She is the best doctor in the hospital where I work.
items.reason: Superlative र निश्चित गरिएको hospital।

items.prompt: ___ children in ___ rural areas often lack access to ___ good schools.
items.answer: Children in rural areas often lack access to good schools.
accepted: Children in rural areas often lack access to good schools.
items.reason: सुरुदेखि अन्त्यसम्म सबै सामान्य plural।

items.prompt: ___ economy grew by ___ five per cent in ___ first quarter.
items.answer: The economy grew by five per cent in the first quarter.
accepted: The economy grew by five per cent in the first quarter.
items.reason: “the economy” एउटा मात्र छ, “five per cent”-अघि कुनै article छैन, “the first quarter” ordinal हो।

items.prompt: ___ solar power is ___ cleaner alternative to ___ fossil fuels.
items.answer: Solar power is a cleaner alternative to fossil fuels.
accepted: Solar power is a cleaner alternative to fossil fuels.
items.reason: सामान्य uncountable “solar power,” पहिलो उल्लेख “a cleaner alternative,” सामान्य plural “fossil fuels.”

blocks: a/an प्रयोग गर्न मिल्छ कि मिल्दैन भन्ने कुरा पहिले एउटा फरकमा भर पर्छ: यो noun गन्न सकिन्छ? information र advice जस्ता uncountable noun-ले कहिल्यै plural -s लिँदैनन्, र एक्लै कहिल्यै a/an लिँदैनन्।
**किन महत्त्वपूर्ण:** article र plural-का नियम लागू हुन्छन् कि हुँदैनन् भन्ने कुरा यही फरकले तय गर्छ, त्यसैले Chapter 3-मा यो सबैभन्दा पहिले आउनुपर्छ।
**Countable noun** गन्न सकिन्छ र यसको plural रूप हुन्छ: one book, two books। Singular-मा यिनले a/an लिन्छन्।
**Uncountable noun** एउटै पूरा मात्रा हो, यसको **plural रूप हुँदैन** र **a/an लाग्दैन**: information (कहिल्यै informations होइन), water, advice।
कण्ठ गर्नुपर्ने, IELTS-मा धेरै प्रयोग हुने set
information, advice, knowledge, research, equipment, furniture, accommodation, traffic, progress, news, money, work, luggage, software, staff, homework.
**partitive phrase** प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्: an advice होइन, a piece of advice; a furniture होइन, a piece of furniture वा an item of furniture।

blocks.title: Exercise 3.2 · Countable र Uncountable गल्ती पत्ता लगाउने
blocks.instructions: हरेक वाक्यमा एउटा noun गलत तरिकाले प्रयोग भएको छ, प्रायः uncountable noun-लाई plural -s वा a / an दिएर। हरेक वाक्य सही बनाएर फेरि लेख्नुहोस्।
